name: Hitbox Viewer
description: Shows hitboxes in levels. Press Left Alt to drop down the hitbox menu.

hitbox-section.name: Hitboxes
hitbox-section.description: Choose what gets drawn. You can also change these from the in-game menu (<cr>Left Alt</c>).

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Master switch for the hitbox viewer.

show-specials.name: Portals, pads, orbs and other special objects (green)

debug-toasts.name: Show popup when the menu opens/closes
debug-toasts.description: Small confirmation popup. Handy for checking that Left Alt is detected.
